style: Speak very fast, like a rapid-fire TikTok voiceover by a cheerful 24-year-old American woman. Energetic, playful, a little sarcastic, natural American accent.

lines.text: Okay, so I asked AI to design my dream bathroom...
...and it gave me this.
Obviously, I have to build it for real.
Full disclaimer: I have zero plumbing experience.
Let's tear out the old one.
Problem one: this floor is basically a science experiment.
Problem two: the AI thinks marble grows on trees.
Problem three: there is no actual plumbing in this plan.
But you know what? We start with the sink.
Step one: cardboard. Extremely load-bearing.
Step two: a bucket. Extremely designer.
Step three: an umbrella. Because the AI put the faucet in the ceiling.
And a concrete block. So it doesn't, you know... move.
So... is it real, or is it AI? Honestly, at this point, neither.
I'm just copying the picture. Badly.
Okay. The basin is finished.
Behold: the AI washbasin.
It's a bucket with a skirt. But the vibe? Correct.
Next, the AI added a fish tank. Right next to the toilet.
Why? No idea. But I already bought the fish.
So now I'm installing an aquarium before I install a toilet.
And apparently the flush goes inside the wall.
I don't have a wall. I have a bucket.
Did that stop me? Obviously not.
We are installing this flush.
Okay. Finished-result time.
The AI bathroom... is real.
The sink works. Sort of. Once.
The toilet? We don't talk about the toilet.
Honestly... this was way harder than it looked.
So... how do I fix this? Comment below.
